import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Erdős Problem 52

*Reference:* [erdosproblems.com/52](https://www.erdosproblems.com/52)
-/

open scoped Pointwise

namespace Erdos52

/--
Let $A$ be a finite set of integers. Is it true that for every $\epsilon>0$
$\max( \lvert A+A\rvert,\lvert AA\rvert)\gg_\epsilon \lvert A\rvert^{2-\epsilon}?$
-/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem erdos_52 : answer(sorry) ↔ ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 → ∃ (C : ℝ), 0 < C ∧ ∀ (A : Finset ℤ),
    (max (A + A).card (A * A).card : ℝ) ≥ C * (A.card : ℝ) ^ (2 - ε) := by
  sorry

-- TODO(firsching): Add additional material.

end Erdos52

reformulations.difference: The source asks for every ε>0 and uses an asymptotic ≫ε bound. Lean restricts to 0<ε<1 but requires the bound for every finite set, including the empty set.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: For nonempty A with n=|A|, the omitted range ε≥1 is automatic: max(|A+A|,|AA|)≥|A+A|≥n≥n^(2−ε), so C=1 works. Conversely, suppose an asymptotic bound holds for n≥N with constant C>0 and 0<ε<1. Replace C by min(C,1/(N+1)^(2−ε)). For 1≤n<N, the new right-hand side is at most 1, whereas |A+A|≥1. The empty set gives 0≥0 because 2−ε>0. A uniform bound immediately implies an asymptotic bound. This equivalence was proved as Review52.restricted_iff_asymptotic in /workspace/review/scratch.lean, without using the theorem under review.
